findings.summary: shipping_cents compares a subtotal in cents against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, which is 50 in whole dollars, so almost every non-empty cart gets free shipping instead of the 799-cent flat rate.

judge.reason: Same cents vs whole-dollar threshold unit mismatch causing free shipping.

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the answer-key bug is always valid_other.
